english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that exists but has not yet become visible or developed.
Use this for an unrealized possibility or capacity, especially before a noun such as 潛在客戶 or 潛在危險.

examples.english: This plan still has many latent problems that may not be immediately apparent.
examples.traditional: 呢個計劃仲有好多潛在問題，未必即刻睇得出。
